description: Open the existing assembly file 'contact_blocks.FCStd'. Organize the two objects ('TopBox' and 'BottomBox') into a new Group named 'Assembly'. Create an exploded view by moving the 'TopBox' object 50 mm in the positive Z direction (upwards). Finally, apply visual styles: set the 'TopBox' Shape Color to Red (R=255, G=0, B=0) with 50% Transparency, and set the 'BottomBox' Shape Color to Blue (R=0, G=0, B=255) with 0% Transparency. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/exploded_assembly.FCStd'.
